title: 第23章 我去县里买药第24章 我以为你有三头六臂呢
content_zh:
丁震和罗阳师徒二人策马扬鞭穿过十里镇人群最密集的街道。
出了小镇，丁震倏然将速度放缓。
罗阳还在一股脑儿的冲。
丁震懒得搭理，往马背上一靠。
边晒太阳边赏景。
罗阳闷着头冲了十来丈。
忽然发现旁边没有动静。
一回头，师父在后面远远吊着呢。
他急忙勒马在路边等。
等丁震慢悠悠过来后，罗阳奇道：“师父，您刚在镇上骑得比风儿快，怎么这会不着急了？”
丁震坐起来，懒洋洋道：“罗阳，学东西呢，不能等师父说，你才学，你得学会用眼睛看。”
罗阳傻眼，不知道什么意思。
“人多的地方，咱们代表的是县衙，在老百姓面前，你得摆出正儿八经的态度，让他们觉得官府的人在好好做事。
但是没人了，你就要考虑自己，我问你，你一个月，拿多少俸禄？”
罗阳想都没想答道：“二两银子。”
“二两银子，能买什么？”
“几十斤肉吧。”
“买了肉呢？”
“买了肉就没了。”
罗阳没搞懂俸禄和赶路有什么联系。

丁震老神在在道：“所以呢，你要对得起自己拿的俸禄，这么着急回去，县太爷能多给你几个子？看看风景，咪咪觉，不比你早回去在他面前溜须拍马强？”
“可是卷宗在咱们手上啊。”罗阳急道。
“卷宗是你我写的，能不能断案，你心里没数？何况我说多少遍，这案子，天王老子来了都办不了。”
丁震有些生气，一根筋的徒弟，教着属实费劲。
干脆又躺倒在马背上，闭目养神。
罗阳不赞同师父的说法。
他觉得年轻人，就应该充满干劲。
混日子，那是二三十年后该干的事情。
可是又不敢忤逆师父。
也只能放缓速度，如坐针毡在马背上动来动去。
就这么熬到傍晚时分。
离县城估摸着还有半个时辰的路程时。
忽地在道上看见一个人。
夕阳下，那人背着包袱。
一瘸一拐看着好不孤单。
“十里镇秀才？”罗阳疑道。
content_en:
Ding Zhen and Luo Yang, masters and apprentices, rode their horses and whipped their whips through the most crowded streets of Shili Town.
After leaving the town, Ding Zhen suddenly slowed down.
Luo Yang was still rushing.
Ding Zhen was too lazy to answer and leaned on the horse.
Enjoy the scenery while basking in the sun.
Luo Yang sullenly rushed ten feet away.
Suddenly, I noticed that there was no movement next to me.
When I turned around, I saw the master hanging far behind.
He hurriedly reined in his horse and waited by the roadside.
After Ding Zhen slowly came over, Luo Yang asked curiously: "Master, you just rode faster than Feng'er in the town, why are you not in a hurry now?"
Ding Zhen sat up and said lazily: "Luo Yang, when you learn something, you can't wait for the master to say it before you learn it. You have to learn to see with your eyes."
Luo Yang was dumbfounded and didn't know what it meant.
"In places where there are many people, we represent the county government. In front of the people, you have to show a serious attitude to make them feel that the people in the government are doing a good job.
But when there is no one left, you have to think about yourself. Let me ask you, how much salary do you get per month? "
Luo Yang replied without thinking: "Two taels of silver."
"What can you buy with two taels of silver?"
"A few dozen kilograms of meat."
"Have you bought some meat?"
“The meat is gone after you buy it.”
Luo Yang didn't understand the connection between salary and traveling.
Old God Ding Zhen said: "So, you have to be worthy of your salary. If you are in such a hurry to go back, how much more money can the county magistrate give you? Look at the scenery, Mimi feels, isn't it better than you to go back early and flatter him in front of him?"
"But the file is in our hands." Luo Yang said anxiously.
"You and I wrote the file. You don't know whether it can resolve the case? Besides, how many times have I told you that even the King of Heaven can't solve this case."
Ding Zhen was a little angry. It was really hard to teach a single-minded apprentice.
Simply lie down on the horse again, close your eyes and rest.
Luo Yang disagreed with his master's statement.
He believes that young people should be full of energy.
Messing around is what you should do twenty or thirty years later.
But I dare not disobey Master.
He could only slow down and move around on horseback like he was sitting on pins and needles.
I stayed up like this until evening.
It was estimated that we were still half an hour away from the county seat.
Suddenly I saw a man on the road.
Under the setting sun, the man was carrying a baggage.
I limped and looked so lonely.
"Shili Town scholar?" Luo Yang asked suspiciously.
